Fig01_Finite_geometry: Original V15 JSON dimensions; HFSS generator v11_geometry.plan; exact copper rectangles, T3 ideal switch only.
Fig02_Search_condition: 7 real P8C candidate scores (V15); finalist P8E condition numbers from V15 independent HFSS mesh analysis.
Fig03_HFSS_high_density_fields: V7401 HFSS P8E 1.825 GHz actual 3034-point complex E field cut-plane exports, 41x37 cells shown, no interpolation; z=min plane 8.1565 mm.
Fig04_Instrument_matrix: Direct reconstruction from V7401 P8E X/Y complex HFSS E-field files at 1.625 GHz; S0 gain set to 1 per row.
Fig05_Convergence_reconstruction: V15 P8D/P8E independent HFSS; calibration on P8E, synthetic coherent six-basis incidence on P8D, thresholds 5% and 10% prespecified.
Fig06_Circular_sensitivity: V15 P8E independent mesh calibrated S3 coefficient; V15 P8D/P8E transfer at 1.625 GHz; independent reconstruction does not meet all gates.
Fig07_Six_state_reconstruction: V7401 P8D fields create six independent-mesh reference-state responses; P8E matrix calibrates. Six axis endpoints, NOT dense independent-sphere validation.
FigS01_Assumed_noise: Monte-Carlo angular precision using HFSS calibrated operator and assumed 0.2% independent intensity noise (source V15).
